research_rationale:
EO 13374 (Amendments to Executive Order 12293, The Foreign Service of the United States; 70 FR 12961) was read in full from the held Federal Register original (two pages). Its three operative sections each perform one act on issue (two amendments of EO 12293 and the revocation of EO 13325), so every clause is spent on issue on 2005-03-14 and the order is not in force on 2026-10-14. The one machine current-law lead (CURRENT:EO:13374#0, 22 U.S.C. 3901 note) only lists this order among the orders that amended EO 12293; it shows the amended text living in the parent order, never this order in force, so it is not a current predicate. The three TERM records are wording leads taken from the replacement text that section 1 inserts into EO 12293 and describe that parent's salary classes, not a condition of this order. The Federal Register catalog note (Amends: EO 12293, February 23, 1981; Revokes: EO 13325, January 23, 2004) describes this order's own acts, and the bounded searches found no later instrument acting on EO 13374.
